summary: Revised spec b66b0eb1 resolves all REV-0001 findings: exact full-suite argv, environment, timeout and parsers are pinned for all five pytest checks with negative tests and a testpaths pin; Validate contracts stays for non-bootstrap mode; recovery.md and pytest-temporary-roots.md are in scope; the self-triggered policy_changed round, shared-failure attribution, --check semantics and the manual 85% coverage run are explicit. Three low advisory notes remain. This task is V1, so its own verify exercises only the V1 merge; the V2 five-check merge is proven by plan and acceptance tests.

findings.title: Check the exact full-suite argv during parsing, before --basetemp is appended
